sign_offs.name: Marjorie Haynes
sign_offs.subject: TRIP
sign_offs.covers: The business trip, approved in advance

must_keep.quote: The lowest logical coach airfare is to be used when traveling on company business.
must_keep.why: the default: the lowest logical coach airfare

must_keep.quote: Book travel in advance and in such a manner to allow for the lowest costs.
must_keep.why: the general duty: book for the lowest costs

must_keep.quote: • Air travel to company-sponsored meetings, functions, center visits, supplier visits or other FXO business travel if booked through Global Travel and approved in advance
must_keep.why: air travel is authorized when booked through Global Travel and approved in advance

must_keep.quote: Airfare if a Team Member insists on traveling on a specific airline instead of using a cheaper fare

design_notes: The VP could fly first (line 138) but asks for economy. Keeping frequent flyer benefits is allowed (line 498), but airfare is not reimbursed when a Team Member insists on a specific airline instead of a cheaper fare (lines 820-821): the cheaper American fare, not United.
